final: WITH first_bl AS (SELECT AVG(pulsepersec) as first_baseline FROM signals WHERE pulsepersec IS NOT NULL), tel_avgs AS (SELECT telescref, AVG(pulsepersec) as avg_pulse FROM signals WHERE pulsepersec IS NOT NULL GROUP BY telescref), above_first AS (SELECT tel_avgs.telescref, tel_avgs.avg_pulse FROM tel_avgs, first_bl WHERE tel_avgs.avg_pulse > first_bl.first_baseline), second_bl AS (SELECT AVG(avg_pulse) as second_baseline FROM above_first), final_tels AS (SELECT above_first.telescref, above_first.avg_pulse FROM above_first, second_bl WHERE above_first.avg_pulse > second_bl.second_baseline) SELECT AVG(avg_pulse) as mean_of_avgs, AVG(avg_pulse - (SELECT first_baseline FROM first_bl)) as mean_exceed_first, AVG(avg_pulse - (SELECT second_baseline FROM second_bl)) as mean_exceed_second FROM final_tels
